The task "well-formed" requires that every pair visits every item exactly once, and does not spend time checking this - it is guaranteed.

Worked example (bbb, ccc)
  (aaa, bbb)
  (ddd, ccc)
Chain rule: after a pair of (A, B), the next pair of (B, A) comes. Start at aaa: the pair (aaa, bbb) comes first; its second item is the dangling end of the chain - so ccc is the ending item in the chain.

So ccc is the last item in this chain
